findings.message: ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is parsed with two separate jq subprocess invocations (one for `.inputs.review_report`, one for `.inputs.gate_aggregator_result`) on the same file; a single `jq` call with two outputs or a `read` from a single invocation would halve the subprocess cost here, which runs on every non-misconfigured invocation.

For the `auto_unless_flagged` policy when the gate verdict is not `pass` and a review_report exists whose `merge_readiness` is not `needs_attention`, `merge_readiness` is extracted from the same file by both the upfront block guard (`_rr_readiness` local to that block) and then again by the `auto_unless_flagged` branch (`_auf_readiness`); the first read's result is not reused, so a redundant jq subprocess is spawned on this code path.

In `_pr_delivery_write_result`, the `_draft` normalisation (`[[ "$_draft" == "true" ]] || _draft="false"`) executes unconditionally before the `[[ -z "$_out_dir" ]] && return 1` guard; the normalisation is wasted work on every call where `_out_dir` is empty and the function exits immediately after.
